semiconductor_relevance: High — OpenSUSI focuses on democratizing semiconductor design through open-source PDKs and EDA tools, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor design ecosystem.
summary: OpenSUSI is dedicated to democratizing semiconductor design by providing open-source process design kits (PDKs) and electronic design automation (EDA) tools. They collaborate with various universities and companies to enhance education and prototyping initiatives, particularly in automotive semiconductor development.
capabilities: Prototyping services utilizing MPW shuttle services
Collaboration with educational institutions for workforce development
Support for automotive semiconductor design initiatives

regional_presence.Japan: OpenSUSI is strengthening collaboration with domestic fabs and building a support system tailored to the Japanese market.
